Attached is the cleaned attendee export. Notes below on segmentation and immediate actions:

- File: 20271001-summit-attendee-export.csv (export columns: name, email, company, title, country, company_size_bucket, intent_score, source_tag)
- VIPs flagged (intent_score >= 80): 7 rows (see tag VIP=true) — includes two Platform leads from Acme and CloudOps (Ben Cho).
- Hot demo candidates (quick win): 18 accounts with intent_score 60–79 and company_size >= 200
- Nurture list: ~230 contacts with intent < 60 — recommend a 3-email nurture drip linking to the replay, blog post, and an on-demand demo card.

Suggested routing (SRD = Sales Rep + SDR play):
- VIPs -> AE outreach within 24 hours + concierge demo (2 seats reserved)
- Hot demo candidates -> SDR sequence (2-touch immediate, then AE intro)
- Nurture -> Automated drip with CTA to schedule a demo

I added a "preferred_demo_window" column based on time zone inference. Aditya — please see the blue rows for candidates I recommend assigning to the East Coast SDR pool.

Marissa
